decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed development, would result in the loss of an existing public house, and has failed to justify the loss of an existing social and community facility, contrary to Adopted UDP policy C.1.1 and Revised Deposit UDP (January 2001) policy C.1.3.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed development, due to its excessively high density, size bulk and massing would constitute an overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's housing standards, and would fail to provide private amenity space, resulting substandard and cramped living conditions, detrimental to the amenity of the future occupiers, and local residents, contrary to Adopted UDP policy ENV.1.1, H.1.2 & H.1.4 and Revised Deposit UDP (January 2001) policy ENVB.1.1, H.4.1 & H.4.2 and associated supplementary planning guidance.

Condition : 3 - 3/ The proposed development, due to its size, position and appearance, would result in an unduly dominant and obtrusive development within the streetscene, resulting in enclosure, loss of light and outlook to the neighbouring property, and would be out of character with the streetscene. The proposal would therefore be detrimental to the character, visual and residential amenities of the area, and would result in the loss of an existing high quality historic building, contrary to Adopted UDP policy ENV.1.1 and H.1.1 and Revised Deposit UDP (January 2001) policy ENVB.1.1 and H.1.1.

Condition : 4 - 4/ The proposed off-street parking provision, due to the insufficient number of bays, and substandard layout, would fail to meet the Council's Parking Standards, and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit January 2001 policy T.1.4.
description: DEMOLITION OF PUBLIC HOUSE AND ERECTION OF A FOUR STOREY BUILDING COMPRISING 8 ONE-BEDROOM FLATS AND 4 TWO-BEDROOM FLATS WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING AND LANDSCAPING
